docs.text: suite_app_backup ¤ Backup MAS Applications Important Supported only for MAS 9.1.x. Backup can only be restored to an instance with the same MAS instance ID. Overview ¤ This role supports backing up MAS application resources and data. Currently supported applications: manage : Backs up Manage namespace resources (CRs, secrets, subscriptions) and persistent volume data facilities : Backs up Facilities namespace resources (CRs, secrets, subscriptions) and persistent volume data Future support planned for: iot , monitor , health , optimizer , visualinspection The backup process creates a timestamped backup directory containing: Namespace Resources : Kubernetes resources including application CRs (ManageApp/FacilitiesApp, ManageWorkspace/FacilitiesWorkspace), secrets, and subscriptions Persistent Volume Data : Application data stored in PVCs (automatically detected from workspace CR) Important An application backup can only be restored to an instance with the same MAS instance ID This role backs up application resources and PV data only. Database backups must be performed separately using the appropriate database backup role For Manage, see the db2 role for database backup For Facilities, see the db2 role for database backup Role Variables ¤ Variable Required Default mas_app_id Yes None mas_instance_id Yes None mas_workspace_id Yes None mas_backup_dir Yes None mas_app_backup_version No Auto-generated timestamp mas_app_backup_include_pvc No true Backup Target ¤ mas_app_id ¤ Defines the MAS application ID for the backup action — currently supported values are manage and facilities . Required Environment Variable: MAS_APP_ID Default: None mas_instance_id ¤ Defines the MAS instance ID for the backup action. Required Environment Variable: MAS_INSTANCE_ID Default: None mas_workspace_id ¤ Defines the MAS workspace ID for the backup action. Required Environment Variable: MAS_WORKSPACE_ID Default: None mas_backup_dir ¤ Defines the directory where backups will be stored, for example /backup/mas . The role will create a timestamped subdirectory within this location. Required Environment Variable: MAS_BACKUP_DIR Default: None Backup Options ¤ mas_app_backup_version ¤ Optional custom version identifier for the backup, for example 20240315-143022 or v1.0-prod . Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_BACKUP_VERSION Default: Auto-generated timestamp in YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS format mas_app_backup_include_pvc ¤ Controls whether persistent volume data is backed up for the application — valid values are true and false . When set to false , only namespace resources (CRs, secrets, subscriptions) are backed up, and PVC data is skipped. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_BACKUP_INCLUDE_PVC Default: true What Gets Backed Up ¤ Manage Application ¤ When backing up the Manage application, the following resources are included: Namespace Resources (automatically backed up): ManageApp CR ManageWorkspace CR Encryption secrets (dynamically determined from ManageWorkspace CR) Certificates with mas.ibm.com/instanceId label Subscription and OperatorGroup IBM entitlement secret All referenced secrets (auto-discovered) Persistent Volume Data (automatically backed up if configured in ManageWorkspace CR): All persistent volumes defined in spec.settings.deployment.persistentVolumes Data is backed up as compressed tar.gz archives Each PVC's mount path is archived separately Archives are stored in the data subdirectory NOT Included (must be backed up separately): Manage database (Db2) - use the db2 role Suite-level resources - use the suite_backup role Facilities Application ¤ When backing up the Facilities application, the following resources are included: Namespace Resources (automatically backed up): FacilitiesApp CR FacilitiesWorkspace CR Encryption secrets (dynamically determined from FacilitiesWorkspace CR) Certificates with mas.ibm.com/instanceId label Subscription and OperatorGroup IBM entitlement secret All referenced secrets (auto-discovered) Persistent Volume Data (automatically backed up if configured in FacilitiesWorkspace CR): All persistent volumes defined in spec.settings.deployment.persistentVolumes Data is backed up as compressed tar.gz archives Each PVC's mount path is archived separately Archives are stored in the data subdirectory NOT Included (must be backed up separately): Facilities database (Db2) - use the db2 role Suite-level resources - use the suite_backup role How Persistent Volume Backup Works ¤ The role automatically detects and backs up persistent volumes configured in the application workspace CR (ManageWorkspace or FacilitiesWorkspace): Detection : Reads spec.settings.deployment.persistentVolumes from the workspace CR Pod Selection : Finds the UI or ALL server bundle pod for the workspace Archive Creation : Creates tar.gz archives of each mount path inside the pod Transfer : Copies archives from pod to local backup directory Cleanup : Removes temporary archives from the pod Example ManageWorkspace CR configuration: spec: settings: deployment: persistentVolumes: - accessModes: - ReadWriteMany mountPath: /jmsstore pvcName: mas-inst1-ws1-jmsserver-pvc size: 25Gi storageClassName: efs-csi - accessModes: - ReadWriteMany mountPath: /usr/share/fonts/truetype/Free3of9Extended pvcName: masms-inst1-ws1-fonts-pvc size: 8Gi storageClassName: efs-csi This configuration will result in two tar.gz archives: mas-inst1-ws1-jmsserver-pvc.tar.gz masms-inst1-ws1-fonts-pvc.tar.gz Example FacilitiesWorkspace CR configuration: spec: settings: deployment: persistentVolumes: - accessModes: - ReadWriteMany mountPath: /jmsstore pvcName: mas-inst1-ws1-jmsserver-pvc size: 25Gi storageClassName: efs-csi This configuration will result in one tar.gz archive: mas-inst1-ws1-jmsserver-pvc.tar.gz Backup Directory Structure ¤ The role creates a backup directory with the following structure: <mas_backup_dir>/ ├── backup-<version>-app-manage/ │ ├── resources/ │ │ ├── projects │ │ │ └── mas-<instance_id>-manage.yaml │ | ├── secrets │ │ │ └── <secret1_name>.yaml │ │ │ └── <secret2_name>.yaml │ | ├── configmaps │ │ │ └── <configmap1_name>.yaml │ │ │ └── <configmap2_name>.yaml │ | ├── subscriptions │ │ │ └── <subscription_name>.yaml │ │ └── ... (other resources) │ └── data/ │ ├── <pvc-name-1>.tar.gz │ ├── <pvc-name-2>.tar.gz └── backup-<version>-app-facilities/ ├── resources/ │ ├── projects │ │ └── mas-<instance_id>-facilities.yaml | ├── secrets │ │ └── <secret1_name>.yaml │ │ └── <secret2_name>.yaml | ├── configmaps │ │ └── <configmap1_name>.yaml │ │ └── <configmap2_name>.yaml | ├── subscriptions │ │ └── <subscription_name>.yaml │ └── ... (other resources) └── data/ ├── <pvc-name-1>.tar.gz Example Playbooks ¤ Basic Backup ¤ Backup Manage namespace resources and any configured persistent volumes: - hosts: localhost any_errors_fatal: true vars: mas_instance_id: inst1 mas_workspace_id: ws1 mas_app_id: manage mas_backup_dir: /backup/mas roles: - ibm.mas_devops.suite_app_backup Backup with Custom Version ¤ Backup with a custom version identifier: - hosts: localhost any_errors_fatal: true vars: mas_instance_id: inst1 mas_workspace_id: ws1 mas_app_id: manage mas_backup_dir: /backup/mas mas_app_backup_version: "prod-backup-20240315" roles: - ibm.mas_devops.suite_app_backup Backup Manage Without PVC Data ¤ Backup only Manage namespace resources, skipping persistent volume data: - hosts: localhost any_errors_fatal: true vars: mas_instance_id: inst1 mas_workspace_id: ws1 mas_app_id: manage mas_backup_dir: /backup/mas mas_app_backup_include_pvc: false roles: - ibm.mas_devops.suite_app_backup Backup Facilities Without PVC Data ¤ Backup only Facilities namespace resources, skipping persistent volume data: - hosts: localhost any_errors_fatal: true vars: mas_instance_id: inst1 mas_workspace_id: ws1 mas_app_id: facilities mas_backup_dir: /backup/mas mas_app_backup_include_pvc: false roles: - ibm.mas_devops.suite_app_backup Backup Facilities with Custom Version ¤ Backup Facilities with a custom version identifier: - hosts: localhost any_errors_fatal: true vars: mas_instance_id: inst1 mas_workspace_id: ws1 mas_app_id: facilities mas_backup_dir: /backup/mas mas_app_backup_version: "prod-backup-20240315" roles: - ibm.mas_devops.suite_app_backup Notes ¤ Database Backup : This role does NOT backup application databases. Use the db2 role to backup Db2 databases separately Suite Resources : This role backs up application-specific resources only. For suite-level resources (Suite CR, workspace CRs, etc.), use the suite_backup role Storage Requirements : Ensure sufficient storage space in mas_backup_dir for both namespace resources and PV data Pod Access : The role uses the UI or ALL server bundle pod to access PVC data. Ensure at least one of these pods is running and healthy Backup Time : PV backup duration depends on the amount of data in the persistent volumes Automatic Detection : Persistent volumes are automatically detected from the application workspace CR - no manual configuration needed Compression : All PV data is compressed using gzip to minimize storage requirements License ¤ EPL-2.0

Instance and Workspace Variables ¤ mas_instance_id ¤ MAS instance identifier for the target installation — a lowercase alphanumeric string of 3-12 characters (e.g. prod , dev , inst1 ). Required Environment Variable: MAS_INSTANCE_ID Default: None Must match the instance ID used during MAS Core installation (suite_install role). The role uses it to locate the correct Suite and Workspace resources; it must be an existing instance — this role does not create new instances. mas_app_id ¤ MAS application whose workspace to configure — one of assist , iot , facilities , manage , monitor , optimizer , predict , visualinspection . Required Environment Variable: MAS_APP_ID Default: None The application must already be installed via the suite_app_install role. Each application supports a different set of configuration variables. mas_workspace_id ¤ Identifier of the workspace within the application to configure — a lowercase alphanumeric string (e.g. masdev , prod , test ). Required Environment Variable: MAS_WORKSPACE_ID Default: None Must match a workspace created during application installation, typically the workspace ID used in suite_app_install. This role configures existing workspaces — it does not create new ones. custom_labels ¤ Comma-separated list of key=value labels to apply to workspace resources (e.g. env=prod,team=platform,app=manage ). Optional Environment Variable: CUSTOM_LABELS Default: None Labels are useful for resource organization, tracking, cost allocation, and custom automation — especially in multi-tenant or multi-workspace environments. They can be used for filtering with oc get commands and monitoring queries, and do not affect workspace functionality. Workspace Configuration Variables ¤ mas_appws_spec ¤ Custom workspace deployment specification, overriding the component-based configuration. Must be valid YAML/JSON matching the application's workspace CR schema. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APPWS_SPEC Default: Application-specific defaults in vars/defaultspecs/{mas_app_id}.yml Warning Setting mas_appws_spec overrides all settings from mas_appws_components . It provides complete control over the workspace spec but requires deep knowledge of the workspace CR structure — incorrect specs can cause deployment failures. Use mas_appws_components for standard deployments; only use this variable when you need advanced customization beyond what component-based configuration offers. mas_appws_bindings_jdbc ¤ JDBC binding scope for the workspace — system (shared system-level database configuration), application , workspace , or workspace-application (combines workspace and application scopes). Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APPWS_BINDINGS_JDBC Default: system Important For Maximo Real Estate and Facilities applications, use the workspace-application scope. The default system scope is suitable for most other applications. JDBC configuration must exist at the specified scope level. mas_appws_components ¤ Application components and versions to configure in the workspace, as comma-separated component=version pairs (e.g. base=latest,health=latest ). Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APPWS_COMPONENTS Default: Application-specific defaults Available components depend on the application (e.g. Manage supports base , health , civil , etc.); use latest for the most recent version or specify an exact version. Overridden by mas_appws_spec when that is set. mas_pod_templates_dir ¤ Directory containing pod template YAML files for customizing Manage workspace and component workloads (Manage only) — enabling resource requests/limits, node selectors, tolerations, and other pod-level settings. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_POD_TEMPLATES_DIR Default: None Pod templates from this directory are merged into the ManageWorkspace CR and applied to specific components or the workspace itself based on filename: ibm-mas-manage-manageworkspace.yml — workspace-level pod templates ibm-mas-manage-imagestitching.yml — civil component pod templates ibm-mas-manage-slackproxy.yml — component pod templates ibm-mas-manage-healthextworkspace.yml — health component pod templates Refer to the MAS CLI BestEfforts templates and Customizing Pod Templates documentation. Predict Configuration Variables ¤ mas_appws_settings_deployment_size ¤ Workload size for Predict containers — developer (1 replica, no high availability), small (2 replicas, basic high availability), medium (3 replicas), or large (higher replica count, if supported). Optional (Predict only) Environment Variable: MAS_APPWS_SETTINGS_DEPLOYMENT_SIZE Default: small The developer size is suitable only for development and testing; production environments should use small or larger for high availability. Watson Studio Local Variables ¤ These variables are only used when using this role to configure Predict , or Health & Predict Utilities . cpd_wsl_project_id ¤ Watson Studio analytics project ID to use for Predict or Health & Predict Utilities configuration, in UUID format. Required unless cpd_wsl_project_name and mas_config_dir are set Environment Variable: CPD_WSL_PROJECT_ID Default: None The project must already exist in Watson Studio (created by the cp4d_service role). Either provide this ID directly, or use the name-based alternative ( cpd_wsl_project_name + mas_config_dir ). cpd_wsl_project_name ¤ Filename (without path) in mas_config_dir where the Watson Studio project ID is saved, as an alternative to providing cpd_wsl_project_id directly. Optional Environment Variable: CPD_WSL_PROJECT_NAME Default: wsl-mas-${mas_instance_id}-hputilities The default filename matches the pattern used by the cp4d_service role. The file must exist in mas_config_dir and contain a valid project ID. mas_config_dir ¤ Local directory containing configuration files, particularly the Watson Studio project ID files (e.g. /home/user/masconfig ). Optional Environment Variable: MAS_CONFIG_DIR Default: None Use the same directory across all MAS setup roles for consistency — the cp4d_service role saves project IDs here, and this role retrieves them. Watson Machine Learning Variables ¤ These variables are only used when using this role to configure Predict . cpd_product_version ¤ Cloud Pak for Data version (e.g. 4.8.0 , 4.8.5 , 5.0.0 ) used to infer the correct Watson Machine Learning version for the Predict workspace configuration. Required (Predict only) Environment Variable: CPD_PRODUCT_VERSION Default: None Must match the CP4D version actually installed in the cluster; an incorrect version may cause WML compatibility issues. cpd_wml_instance_id ¤ Watson Machine Learning instance identifier to configure in the Predict workspace. Optional (Predict only) Environment Variable: CPD_WML_INSTANCE_ID Default: openshift The default suits most deployments; a custom value must match an existing WML instance in CP4D. cpd_wml_url ¤ Watson Machine Learning service URL — typically the same as the Cloud Pak for Data URL (e.g. https://internal-nginx-svc.{namespace}.svc:12443 ). Optional (Predict only) Environment Variable: CPD_WML_URL Default: https://internal-nginx-svc.ibm-cpd.svc:12443 The default assumes CP4D is installed in the ibm-cpd namespace; if CP4D is in a different namespace, update the URL accordingly (e.g. https://internal-nginx-svc.my-cpd-namespace.svc:12443 ). AI Service Integration ¤ These variables configure the AI Service integration with the Manage application. aiservice_instance_id ¤ AI Service instance ID to integrate with the Manage application (e.g. aiservice1 , ai-prod ). Optional Environment Variable: AISERVICE_INSTANCE_ID Default: None Must be used together with aiservice_tenant_id . When set, the role automatically retrieves the API key from the tenant-specific secret aiservice-{instance_id}-{tenant_id}----apikey-secret , extracts the service URL from the aibroker route in namespace aiservice-{instance_id} , imports the TLS certificate from secret {instance_id}-public-aibroker-tls , configures the connection properties in the Manage encryption secret, and verifies AI Service health before proceeding. aiservice_tenant_id ¤ AI Service tenant ID to use for the integration (e.g. tenant1 , prod-tenant ), combined with the instance ID to form the fully qualified tenant name. Required when aiservice_instance_id is set Environment Variable: AISERVICE_TENANT_ID Default: None The tenant must already exist in the AI Service instance; the role retrieves credentials from the tenant-specific secret in the cluster. Health Integration ¤ mas_appws_bindings_health_wsl_flag ¤ Whether to bind Watson Studio to the Manage Health component — true or false . Optional (Manage Health only) Environment Variable: MAS_APPWS_BINDINGS_HEALTH_WSL_FLAG Default: false Setting this to true enables Watson Studio integration with Health, providing advanced analytics capabilities. A system-level WatsonStudioCfg must exist in the cluster before enabling this (Watson Studio installed and configured via CP4D). Used together with mas_appws_bindings_health_wsl . mas_appws_bindings_health_wsl ¤ Watson Studio binding scope for the Manage Health component — set to system when Watson Studio is configured at system level. Optional (Manage Health only) Environment Variable: MAS_APPWS_BINDINGS_HEALTH_WSL Default: None Used together with mas_appws_bindings_health_wsl_flag=true ; Watson Studio must be installed and configured via CP4D with a system-level WatsonStudioCfg before using this binding. Server Bundle Configuration ¤ mas_app_settings_server_bundles_size ¤ Flavor of server bundle configuration used to handle workload for the Manage application. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_SERVER_BUNDLES_SIZE Default: dev Currently supported server bundle sizes: dev — deploys Manage with the default server bundle configuration (a single bundle pod handling all Manage application workload) small — deploys Manage with the most common deployment configuration (4 bundle pods, each handling workload for one main capability: mea , cron , report , and ui ) jms — Manage 8.4 and above; same server bundle configuration as small plus a jms bundle pod. Enabling the JMS pod workload also configures Manage to use default JMS messaging queues stored in the {{ mas_app_settings_jms_queue_mount_path }}/jmsstore persistent volume mount path snojms — Manage 8.4 and above; includes all and jms bundle pods. Enabling the JMS pod workload also configures Manage to use default JMS messaging queues stored in the {{ mas_app_settings_jms_queue_mount_path }}/jmsstore persistent volume mount path For more details about the Manage application server bundle configuration, refer to Setting the server bundles for Manage application . Optional Environment Variable: MAS_FACILITIES_STORAGE_USERFILES_CLASS Default: None — a default storage class is auto-defined according to your cluster's available storage classes mas_ws_facilities_storage_userfiles_mode ¤ Attach mode of the Userfiles PVC. Both ReadWriteOnce (block storage class) and ReadWriteMany (file storage class) are supported. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_FACILITIES_STORAGE_USERFILES_MODE Default: ReadWriteOnce mas_ws_facilities_storage_userfiles_size ¤ Size of the Userfiles PVC, in Gigabytes. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_FACILITIES_STORAGE_USERFILES_SIZE Default: 50 Facilities Agents Deployment Flexibility Settings ¤ Agents Deployment Flexibility enables you to override the default agent deployment strategy defined by the size attribute. This feature is activated when at least one of the following 13 agent deployment properties is set to a valid, non-empty value. Once activated, any properties that are empty or contain invalid values will be interpreted as if they were equal to shared . mas_ws_facilities_dataconnectagent_deploymentmode ¤ Whether the dataconnectagent agent is activated in the shared multiagents pod, in a dedicated pod, or is disabled — allowed non-empty values are dedicated , disabled , and shared . Optional Environment Variable: MAS_FACILITIES_DATACONNECTAGENT_DEPLOYMENTMODE Default: '' mas_ws_facilities_extendedformulaagent_deploymentmode ¤ Whether the extendedformulaagent agent is activated in the shared multiagents pod, in a dedicated pod, or is disabled — allowed non-empty values are dedicated , disabled , and shared . Optional Environment Variable: MAS_FACILITIES_EXTENDEDFORMULAAGENT_DEPLOYMENTMODE Default: '' mas_ws_facilities_formularecalcagent_deploymentmode ¤ Whether the formularecalcagent agent is activated in the shared multiagents pod, in a dedicated pod, or is disabled — allowed non-empty values are dedicated , disabled , and shared . Optional Environment Variable: MAS_FACILITIES_FORMULARECALCAGENT_DEPLOYMENTMODE Default: '' mas_ws_facilities_incomingmailagent_deploymentmode ¤ Whether the incomingmailagent agent is activated in the shared multiagents pod, in a dedicated pod, or is disabled — allowed non-empty values are dedicated , disabled , and shared . Optional Environment Variable: MAS_FACILITIES_INCOMINGMAILAGENT_DEPLOYMENTMODE Default: '' mas_ws_facilities_objectmigrationagent_deploymentmode ¤ Whether the objectmigrationagent agent is activated in the shared multiagents pod, in a dedicated pod, or is disabled — allowed non-empty values are dedicated , disabled , and shared . Optional Environment Variable: MAS_FACILITIES_OBJECTMIGRATIONAGENT_DEPLOYMENTMODE Default: '' mas_ws_facilities_objectpublishagent_deploymentmode ¤ Whether the objectpublishagent agent is activated in the shared multiagents pod, in a dedicated pod, or is disabled — allowed non-empty values are dedicated , disabled , and shared . Optional Environment Variable: MAS_FACILITIES_OBJECTPUBLISHAGENT_DEPLOYMENTMODE Default: '' mas_ws_facilities_maintenanceagent_deploymentmode ¤ Whether the maintenanceagent agent is activated in the shared multiagents pod, in a dedicated pod, or is disabled — allowed non-empty values are dedicated , disabled , and shared . Optional Environment Variable: MAS_FACILITIES_MAINTENANCEAGENT_DEPLOYMENTMODE Default: '' mas_ws_facilities_reportqueueagent_deploymentmode ¤ Whether the reportqueueagent agent is activated in the shared multiagents pod or in a dedicated pod — allowed non-empty values are dedicated and shared ; this agent cannot be disabled. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_FACILITIES_REPORTQUEUEAGENT_DEPLOYMENTMODE Default: '' mas_ws_facilities_wfagent_deploymentmode ¤ Whether the wfagent agent is activated in the shared multiagents pod or in a dedicated pod — allowed non-empty values are dedicated and shared ; this agent cannot be disabled. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_FACILITIES_WFAGENT_DEPLOYMENTMODE Default: '' mas_ws_facilities_wffutureagent_deploymentmode ¤ Whether the wffutureagent agent is activated in the shared multiagents pod, in a dedicated pod, or is disabled — allowed non-empty values are dedicated , disabled , and shared . Optional Environment Variable: MAS_FACILITIES_WFFUTUREAGENT_DEPLOYMENTMODE Default: '' mas_ws_facilities_wfnotificationagent_deploymentmode ¤ Whether the wfnotificationagent agent is activated in the shared multiagents pod, in a dedicated pod, or is disabled — allowed non-empty values are dedicated , disabled , and shared . Optional Environment Variable: MAS_FACILITIES_WFNOTIFICATIONAGENT_DEPLOYMENTMODE Default: '' mas_ws_facilities_reservesmtpagent_deploymentmode ¤ Whether the reservesmtpagent agent is activated in the shared multiagents pod, in a dedicated pod, or is disabled — allowed non-empty values are dedicated , disabled , and shared . Optional Environment Variable: MAS_FACILITIES_RESERVESMTPAGENT_DEPLOYMENTMODE Default: '' mas_ws_facilities_scheduleragent_deploymentmode ¤ Whether the scheduleragent agent is activated in the shared multiagents pod, in a dedicated pod, or is disabled — allowed non-empty values are dedicated , disabled , and shared . Optional Environment Variable: MAS_FACILITIES_SCHEDULERAGENT_DEPLOYMENTMODE Default: '' Example Playbook ¤ - hosts: localhost any_errors_fatal: true vars: # MAS configuration mas_instance_id: "{{ lookup('env', 'MAS_INSTANCE_ID') }}" # MAS workspace configuration mas_workspace_id: "{{ lookup('env', 'MAS_WORKSPACE_ID') }}" # MAS application configuration mas_app_id: "{{ lookup('env', 'MAS_APP_ID') }}" mas_appws_spec: bindings: jdbc: "{{ mas_appws_jdbc_binding | default( 'system' , true) }}" roles: - ibm.mas_devops.suite_app_config License ¤ EPL-2.0

docs.title: Role Variables

docs.text: MAS instance identifier for the target installation — a lowercase alphanumeric string of 3-12 characters (e.g. prod , dev , inst1 ). Required Environment Variable: MAS_INSTANCE_ID Default: None Must match the instance ID used during MAS Core installation (suite_install role). The role uses it to locate the correct Suite and Workspace resources; it must be an existing instance — this role does not create new instances.
docs.title: mas_instance_id

docs.text: MAS application whose workspace to configure — one of assist , iot , facilities , manage , monitor , optimizer , predict , visualinspection . Required Environment Variable: MAS_APP_ID Default: None The application must already be installed via the suite_app_install role. Each application supports a different set of configuration variables.
docs.title: mas_app_id

docs.text: Identifier of the workspace within the application to configure — a lowercase alphanumeric string (e.g. masdev , prod , test ). Required Environment Variable: MAS_WORKSPACE_ID Default: None Must match a workspace created during application installation, typically the workspace ID used in suite_app_install. This role configures existing workspaces — it does not create new ones.
docs.title: mas_workspace_id

docs.text: Comma-separated list of key=value labels to apply to workspace resources (e.g. env=prod,team=platform,app=manage ). Optional Environment Variable: CUSTOM_LABELS Default: None Labels are useful for resource organization, tracking, cost allocation, and custom automation — especially in multi-tenant or multi-workspace environments. They can be used for filtering with oc get commands and monitoring queries, and do not affect workspace functionality.
docs.title: custom_labels

docs.text: Custom workspace deployment specification, overriding the component-based configuration. Must be valid YAML/JSON matching the application's workspace CR schema. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APPWS_SPEC Default: Application-specific defaults in vars/defaultspecs/{mas_app_id}.yml Warning Setting mas_appws_spec overrides all settings from mas_appws_components . It provides complete control over the workspace spec but requires deep knowledge of the workspace CR structure — incorrect specs can cause deployment failures. Use mas_appws_components for standard deployments; only use this variable when you need advanced customization beyond what component-based configuration offers.
docs.title: mas_appws_spec

docs.text: JDBC binding scope for the workspace — system (shared system-level database configuration), application , workspace , or workspace-application (combines workspace and application scopes). Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APPWS_BINDINGS_JDBC Default: system Important For Maximo Real Estate and Facilities applications, use the workspace-application scope. The default system scope is suitable for most other applications. JDBC configuration must exist at the specified scope level.
docs.title: mas_appws_bindings_jdbc

docs.text: Application components and versions to configure in the workspace, as comma-separated component=version pairs (e.g. base=latest,health=latest ). Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APPWS_COMPONENTS Default: Application-specific defaults Available components depend on the application (e.g. Manage supports base , health , civil , etc.); use latest for the most recent version or specify an exact version. Overridden by mas_appws_spec when that is set.
docs.title: mas_appws_components

docs.text: Directory containing pod template YAML files for customizing Manage workspace and component workloads (Manage only) — enabling resource requests/limits, node selectors, tolerations, and other pod-level settings. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_POD_TEMPLATES_DIR Default: None Pod templates from this directory are merged into the ManageWorkspace CR and applied to specific components or the workspace itself based on filename: ibm-mas-manage-manageworkspace.yml — workspace-level pod templates ibm-mas-manage-imagestitching.yml — civil component pod templates ibm-mas-manage-slackproxy.yml — component pod templates ibm-mas-manage-healthextworkspace.yml — health component pod templates Refer to the MAS CLI BestEfforts templates and Customizing Pod Templates documentation.
docs.title: mas_pod_templates_dir

docs.text: Workload size for Predict containers — developer (1 replica, no high availability), small (2 replicas, basic high availability), medium (3 replicas), or large (higher replica count, if supported). Optional (Predict only) Environment Variable: MAS_APPWS_SETTINGS_DEPLOYMENT_SIZE Default: small The developer size is suitable only for development and testing; production environments should use small or larger for high availability.
docs.title: mas_appws_settings_deployment_size

docs.text: These variables are only used when using this role to configure Predict , or Health & Predict Utilities .
docs.title: Watson Studio Local Variables

docs.text: Watson Studio analytics project ID to use for Predict or Health & Predict Utilities configuration, in UUID format. Required unless cpd_wsl_project_name and mas_config_dir are set Environment Variable: CPD_WSL_PROJECT_ID Default: None The project must already exist in Watson Studio (created by the cp4d_service role). Either provide this ID directly, or use the name-based alternative ( cpd_wsl_project_name + mas_config_dir ).
docs.title: cpd_wsl_project_id

docs.text: Filename (without path) in mas_config_dir where the Watson Studio project ID is saved, as an alternative to providing cpd_wsl_project_id directly. Optional Environment Variable: CPD_WSL_PROJECT_NAME Default: wsl-mas-${mas_instance_id}-hputilities The default filename matches the pattern used by the cp4d_service role. The file must exist in mas_config_dir and contain a valid project ID.
docs.title: cpd_wsl_project_name

docs.text: Local directory containing configuration files, particularly the Watson Studio project ID files (e.g. /home/user/masconfig ). Optional Environment Variable: MAS_CONFIG_DIR Default: None Use the same directory across all MAS setup roles for consistency — the cp4d_service role saves project IDs here, and this role retrieves them.
docs.title: mas_config_dir

docs.text: These variables are only used when using this role to configure Predict .
docs.title: Watson Machine Learning Variables

docs.text: Cloud Pak for Data version (e.g. 4.8.0 , 4.8.5 , 5.0.0 ) used to infer the correct Watson Machine Learning version for the Predict workspace configuration. Required (Predict only) Environment Variable: CPD_PRODUCT_VERSION Default: None Must match the CP4D version actually installed in the cluster; an incorrect version may cause WML compatibility issues.
docs.title: cpd_product_version

docs.text: Watson Machine Learning instance identifier to configure in the Predict workspace. Optional (Predict only) Environment Variable: CPD_WML_INSTANCE_ID Default: openshift The default suits most deployments; a custom value must match an existing WML instance in CP4D.
docs.title: cpd_wml_instance_id

docs.text: Watson Machine Learning service URL — typically the same as the Cloud Pak for Data URL (e.g. https://internal-nginx-svc.{namespace}.svc:12443 ). Optional (Predict only) Environment Variable: CPD_WML_URL Default: https://internal-nginx-svc.ibm-cpd.svc:12443 The default assumes CP4D is installed in the ibm-cpd namespace; if CP4D is in a different namespace, update the URL accordingly (e.g. https://internal-nginx-svc.my-cpd-namespace.svc:12443 ).
docs.title: cpd_wml_url

docs.text: These variables configure the AI Service integration with the Manage application.
docs.title: AI Service Integration

docs.text: AI Service instance ID to integrate with the Manage application (e.g. aiservice1 , ai-prod ). Optional Environment Variable: AISERVICE_INSTANCE_ID Default: None Must be used together with aiservice_tenant_id . When set, the role automatically retrieves the API key from the tenant-specific secret aiservice-{instance_id}-{tenant_id}----apikey-secret , extracts the service URL from the aibroker route in namespace aiservice-{instance_id} , imports the TLS certificate from secret {instance_id}-public-aibroker-tls , configures the connection properties in the Manage encryption secret, and verifies AI Service health before proceeding.
docs.title: aiservice_instance_id

docs.text: AI Service tenant ID to use for the integration (e.g. tenant1 , prod-tenant ), combined with the instance ID to form the fully qualified tenant name. Required when aiservice_instance_id is set Environment Variable: AISERVICE_TENANT_ID Default: None The tenant must already exist in the AI Service instance; the role retrieves credentials from the tenant-specific secret in the cluster.
docs.title: aiservice_tenant_id

docs.text: Whether to bind Watson Studio to the Manage Health component — true or false . Optional (Manage Health only) Environment Variable: MAS_APPWS_BINDINGS_HEALTH_WSL_FLAG Default: false Setting this to true enables Watson Studio integration with Health, providing advanced analytics capabilities. A system-level WatsonStudioCfg must exist in the cluster before enabling this (Watson Studio installed and configured via CP4D). Used together with mas_appws_bindings_health_wsl .
docs.title: mas_appws_bindings_health_wsl_flag

docs.text: Watson Studio binding scope for the Manage Health component — set to system when Watson Studio is configured at system level. Optional (Manage Health only) Environment Variable: MAS_APPWS_BINDINGS_HEALTH_WSL Default: None Used together with mas_appws_bindings_health_wsl_flag=true ; Watson Studio must be installed and configured via CP4D with a system-level WatsonStudioCfg before using this binding.
docs.title: mas_appws_bindings_health_wsl

docs.text: Whether the Asset Investment Optimization (AIO) resource must be loaded into Manage — only supported when the Optimizer application is installed. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_AIO_FLAG Default: true
docs.title: mas_app_settings_aio_flag

docs.text: Name of the schema where the Manage database lives; the deprecated mas_app_settings_db2_schema variable name is also supported. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_DB_SCHEMA Default: maximo
docs.title: mas_app_settings_db_schema

docs.text: Whether Manage demo data should be loaded. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_DEMODATA Default: false (do not load demodata)
docs.title: mas_app_settings_demodata

docs.text: Whether VARGRAPHIC ( true ) or VARCHAR ( false ) is used — see Language Support for details. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_DB2VARGRAPHIC Default: true
docs.title: mas_app_settings_db2vargraphic

docs.text: Name of the Manage database tablespace. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_TABLESPACE Default: MAXDATA
docs.title: mas_app_settings_tablespace

docs.text: Name of the Manage database indexspace. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_INDEXSPACE Default: MAXINDEX
docs.title: mas_app_settings_indexspace

docs.text: Whether persistent volumes are configured by default during Manage Workspace activation. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_PERSISTENT_VOLUMES_FLAG Default: false When set to true , two defaulted file storage Persistent Volume Claim resources are created out of the box for Manage: /DOCLINKS — persistent volume used to store doclinks/attachments /bim — persistent volume used to store Building Information Models related artifacts (models, docs and import)
docs.title: mas_app_settings_persistent_volumes_flag

docs.text: The following properties can be defined to customize the persistent volume for the JMS queues setup for Manage. JMS configuration is only performed when mas_app_settings_server_bundles_size is set to jms or snojms .
docs.title: JMS Queues

docs.text: Persistent volume storage class for the JMS queue configuration. Both ReadWriteOnce (block storage class) and ReadWriteMany (file storage class) access modes are supported. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_JMS_QUEUE_PVC_STORAGE_CLASS Default: None — a default storage class is auto-defined according to your cluster's available storage classes
docs.title: mas_app_settings_jms_queue_pvc_storage_class

docs.text: Persistent volume claim name for the JMS queue configuration. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_JMS_QUEUE_PVC_NAME Default: manage-jms
docs.title: mas_app_settings_jms_queue_pvc_name

docs.text: Persistent volume claim size for the JMS queue configuration. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_JMS_QUEUE_PVC_SIZE Default: 20Gi
docs.title: mas_app_settings_jms_queue_pvc_size

docs.text: Persistent volume storage mount path for the JMS queue configuration. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_JMS_QUEUE_MOUNT_PATH Default: /jms
docs.title: mas_app_settings_jms_queue_mount_path

docs.text: Persistent volume storage access mode for the JMS queue configuration — typically ReadWriteOnce (block storage class) or ReadWriteMany (file storage class). Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_JMS_QUEUE_PVC_ACCESSMODE Default: ReadWriteMany
docs.title: mas_app_settings_jms_queue_pvc_accessmode

docs.text: Whether JMS continuous queues are configured. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_DEFAULT_JMS Default: false
docs.title: mas_app_settings_default_jms

docs.text: The following properties can be defined to customize the persistent volumes for the Doclinks/Attachments setup for Manage.
docs.title: Doclinks/Attachments

docs.text: Persistent volume storage class for the doclinks/attachments configuration. Both ReadWriteOnce (block storage class) and ReadWriteMany (file storage class) are supported. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_DOCLINKS_PVC_STORAGE_CLASS Default: None — a default storage class is auto-defined according to your cluster's available storage classes
docs.title: mas_app_settings_doclinks_pvc_storage_class

docs.text: Persistent volume claim name for the doclinks/attachments configuration. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_DOCLINKS_PVC_NAME Default: manage-doclinks
docs.title: mas_app_settings_doclinks_pvc_name

docs.text: Persistent volume claim size for the doclinks/attachments configuration. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_DOCLINKS_PVC_SIZE Default: 20Gi
docs.title: mas_app_settings_doclinks_pvc_size

docs.text: Persistent volume storage mount path for the doclinks/attachments configuration. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_DOCLINKS_MOUNT_PATH Default: /DOCLINKS
docs.title: mas_app_settings_doclinks_mount_path

docs.text: Persistent volume storage access mode for the doclinks/attachments configuration — typically ReadWriteOnce (block storage class) or ReadWriteMany (file storage class). Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_DOCLINKS_PVC_ACCESSMODE Default: ReadWriteMany
docs.title: mas_app_settings_doclinks_pvc_accessmode

docs.text: The following properties configure the persistent volume for the Kafka Image Processor component when the Civil Infrastructure component is enabled. Important As of Manage 9.2, these properties are required when the Civil Infrastructure component is enabled. They are not supported in earlier releases. The role automatically detects the Manage version and only includes these settings when Manage >= 9.2.
docs.title: Kafka Image Processor (Civil Component)

docs.text: Persistent volume storage class for the Kafka Image Processor configuration. The PVC is created with ReadWriteMany access mode, as it must be shared between the Manage/Civil and KafkaImageProcessor deployments. Optional (automatically included when the Civil component is enabled in Manage 9.2+) Environment Variable: MAS_MANAGE_KAFKAIMAGEPROCESSOR_PVC_STORAGECLASS Default: None — a default storage class is auto-defined according to your cluster's available storage classes
docs.title: mas_manage_kafkaimageprocessor_pvc_storageclass

docs.text: Persistent volume claim size for the Kafka Image Processor configuration. Optional (automatically included when the Civil component is enabled in Manage 9.2+) Environment Variable: MAS_MANAGE_KAFKAIMAGEPROCESSOR_PVC_SIZE Default: 10Gi
docs.title: mas_manage_kafkaimageprocessor_pvc_size

docs.text: The following properties can be defined to customize the persistent volumes for the Building Information Models setup for Manage.
docs.title: BIM (Building Information Models)

docs.text: Persistent volume storage class for the Building Information Models configuration. Both ReadWriteOnce (block storage class) and ReadWriteMany (file storage class) are supported. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_BIM_PVC_STORAGE_CLASS Default: None — a default storage class is auto-defined according to your cluster's available storage classes
docs.title: mas_app_settings_bim_pvc_storage_class

docs.text: Persistent volume claim name for the Building Information Models configuration. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_BIM_PVC_NAME Default: manage-bim
docs.title: mas_app_settings_bim_pvc_name

docs.text: Persistent volume claim size for the Building Information Models configuration. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_BIM_PVC_SIZE Default: 20Gi
docs.title: mas_app_settings_bim_pvc_size

docs.text: Persistent volume storage mount path for the Building Information Models configuration. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_BIM_MOUNT_PATH Default: /bim
docs.title: mas_app_settings_bim_mount_path

docs.text: Persistent volume storage access mode for the Building Information Models configuration — typically ReadWriteOnce (block storage class) or ReadWriteMany (file storage class). Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_BIM_PVC_ACCESSMODE Default: ReadWriteMany
docs.title: mas_app_settings_bim_pvc_accessmode

docs.text: Base language for the Manage application. For a full list of supported languages and their corresponding language codes, refer to the Language Support documentation. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_BASE_LANG Default: EN (English)
docs.title: mas_app_settings_base_lang

docs.text: Additional secondary languages for the Manage application, as comma-separated language codes. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_SECONDARY_LANGS Default: None For example, use the following to enable the Manage application with Arabic, Deutsch, and Japanese as secondary languages: export MAS_APP_SETTINGS_SECONDARY_LANGS='AR,DE,JA' The more languages you add, the longer Manage will take to install and activate. For a full list of supported languages and their corresponding language codes, refer to the Language Support documentation.
docs.title: mas_app_settings_secondary_langs

docs.text: Flavor of server bundle configuration used to handle workload for the Manage application. Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_SETTINGS_SERVER_BUNDLES_SIZE Default: dev Currently supported server bundle sizes: dev — deploys Manage with the default server bundle configuration (a single bundle pod handling all Manage application workload) small — deploys Manage with the most common deployment configuration (4 bundle pods, each handling workload for one main capability: mea , cron , report , and ui ) jms — Manage 8.4 and above; same server bundle configuration as small plus a jms bundle pod. Enabling the JMS pod workload also configures Manage to use default JMS messaging queues stored in the {{ mas_app_settings_jms_queue_mount_path }}/jmsstore persistent volume mount path snojms — Manage 8.4 and above; includes all and jms bundle pods. Enabling the JMS pod workload also configures Manage to use default JMS messaging queues stored in the {{ mas_app_settings_jms_queue_mount_path }}/jmsstore persistent volume mount path For more details about the Manage application server bundle configuration, refer to Setting the server bundles for Manage application .

docs.text: suite_app_config_manage ¤ This role provides post-installation configuration actions for the Maximo Manage application. It consolidates the former suite_manage_*_config roles into a single role, with the suite_app_config_manage_actions parameter selecting which actions to run — either one at a time or several together as part of the initial configuration of a Manage workspace. Prerequisites Manage application must be installed and its workspace ready before running any action Actions that execute SQL against the Manage database ( bim , logging with mas_manage_logging_is_prod ) require the Db2 Warehouse instance to be available and are not supported with an external (JDBC) database Actions ¤ Action Former role Description attachments suite_manage_attachments_config Configure where Manage stores attachment files: PVC file storage, IBM Cloud Object Storage or AWS S3 (CR-based configuration only) bim suite_manage_bim_config Configure BIM (Building Information Models) support: create the BIM folders on the mounted PVC and set the bim.* system properties birt suite_manage_birt_report_config Configure the BIRT report server bundle for Manage custfiles suite_manage_customer_files_config Provision the IBM COS / AWS S3 buckets (main, recovery, backup) used to store Manage customer files, and import the storage certificates eventstreams configure_manage_eventstreams Configure Manage to use IBM Cloud Event Streams: import the Event Streams certificates, set the mxe.* system properties and insert the Kafka message hub provider, queues and cron task definitions imagestitching suite_manage_imagestitching_config Configure persistent storage for Manage image stitching files (Civil component) import-certs suite_manage_import_certs_config Import certificates into the ManageWorkspace CR so they are added to the Manage truststore dbc-scripts suite_manage_load_dbc_scripts Load DBC (database configuration) scripts into the Manage database via the maxinst pod logging suite_manage_logging_config Configure the COS/S3 destination for Manage server log uploads and (optionally) lock down the Admin Center on production databases pvc suite_manage_pvc_config Add custom persistent volumes to the ManageWorkspace CR Role Variables ¤ Variable Required Default suite_app_config_manage_actions Yes None mas_instance_id Yes None mas_workspace_id Yes None mas_app_id No manage mas_manage_attachments_provider No filestorage mas_manage_custfiles_provider Conditional Legacy COS_TYPE mas_manage_logging_provider Conditional Legacy COS_TYPE mas_manage_birt_report_bundle_name No rpt mas_manage_eventstreams_name Conditional None mas_manage_imagestitching_pvc_name No manage-imagestitching manage_certificates Conditional None mas_manage_dbc_script_path_local Conditional None mas_manage_custom_persistent_volumes Conditional None db2_instance_name Conditional None Most action-specific variables are only required when the corresponding action is selected; the condition is noted in each entry. Actions and MAS Targeting ¤ suite_app_config_manage_actions ¤ The actions to run, either as a list or as a comma-separated string — any combination of attachments , bim , birt , custfiles , eventstreams , imagestitching , import-certs , dbc-scripts , logging , and pvc . Required Environment Variable: SUITE_APP_CONFIG_MANAGE_ACTIONS Default: None Each action corresponds to one of the former suite_manage_*_config roles. Running multiple actions in one invocation is more efficient than invoking the role several times, for example attachments,bim configures both attachment storage and BIM support in a single run. mas_instance_id ¤ MAS instance identifier — identifies which MAS instance contains the Manage application to configure. Required Environment Variable: MAS_INSTANCE_ID Default: None mas_workspace_id ¤ MAS workspace identifier — identifies the workspace containing the Manage application to configure. Required Environment Variable: MAS_WORKSPACE_ID Default: None mas_app_id ¤ Application identifier — set to health when configuring a Health stand-alone application (supported by the attachments , bim and dbc-scripts actions). Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_ID Default: manage Storage Providers ¤ mas_manage_attachments_provider ¤ Attachment storage provider (action: attachments ) — filestorage , ibm , or aws . Optional Environment Variable: MAS_MANAGE_ATTACHMENTS_PROVIDER Default: filestorage Only the CR-based configuration is supported: the former db configuration mode (raw SQL against the Manage database) has been removed, and setting mas_manage_attachment_configuration_mode to db fails with a migration message. The variable is retained so that playbooks setting it to cr continue to work. When the provider is ibm , the bucket is created via the cos_bucket role with an object expiry rule enabled by default that deletes objects after 60 days — set COS_BUCKET_EXPIRE_RULE_ENABLE_FLAG=False to disable the rule, or adjust the retention period with COS_BUCKET_EXPIRE_RULE_DAYS . mas_manage_custfiles_provider ¤ Customer files storage provider (action: custfiles ) — ibm or aws . Required for the action Environment Variable: MAS_MANAGE_CUSTFILES_PROVIDER (falls back to the legacy COS_TYPE ) Default: Value of the legacy COS_TYPE environment variable ( None if unset) mas_manage_logging_provider ¤ Manage log upload storage provider (action: logging ) — ibm or aws . Required for the action Environment Variable: MAS_MANAGE_LOGGING_PROVIDER (falls back to the legacy COS_TYPE ) Default: Value of the legacy COS_TYPE environment variable ( None if unset) Related settings: mas_manage_logging_is_prod ( false ; enables the Admin Center lockdown on production databases), mas_manage_logging_secret_name ( s3secretkey ), and mas_manage_logging_force ( false ; reconfigure logging even when a destination is already set). Action-Specific Settings ¤ mas_manage_birt_report_bundle_name ¤ Name used for the report server bundle when one is not already configured (action: birt ). Optional Environment Variable: MANAGE_REPORT_BUNDLE_SERVER_NAME Default: rpt mas_manage_eventstreams_name ¤ The IBM Cloud Event Streams instance name (action: eventstreams ) — identifies the Event Streams service instance whose Kafka brokers Manage is configured to use. Required for the action Environment Variable: EVENTSTREAMS_NAME Default: None Related settings: mas_manage_eventstreams_location ( us-east ), ibmcloud_apikey , ibmcloud_resourcegroup ( Default ), db2wh_dbname ( BLUDB ), cpd_meta_namespace (the CP4D namespace hosting the Manage Db2 Warehouse), and mas_manage_eventstreams_manage_url_subdomain ( main ; the former role hardcoded this value, override when the Manage UI route uses a different workspace subdomain). Warning This action inserts a dummy Kafka password during configuration (not the actual one); the real password must be configured manually via the Manage administration dashboard afterwards. mas_manage_imagestitching_pvc_name ¤ Name of the PVC used for image stitching files (action: imagestitching ). Optional Environment Variable: IMAGESTITCHING_PVCNAME Default: manage-imagestitching Related settings: mas_manage_imagestitching_storage_class (defaults to the cluster RWX storage class), mas_manage_imagestitching_storage_size ( 20Gi ), mas_manage_imagestitching_storage_mode ( ReadWriteMany ), and mas_manage_imagestitching_mount_path ( imagestitching ). manage_certificates ¤ List of PEM certificate strings to import into the Manage truststore (action: import-certs ). Requires manage_certificates_alias_prefix . Required for the action (or provide manage_certificates_file_path_local ) Environment Variable: None (passed as variable; manage_certificates_file_path_local uses MANAGE_CERTIFICATES_FILE_PATH_LOCAL ) Default: None When invoked from suite_app_config for the AI Service integration, these variables are set automatically. mas_manage_dbc_script_path_local ¤ Local folder containing the .dbc scripts to load (action: dbc-scripts ). Required for the action Environment Variable: DBC_SCRIPT_PATH_LOCAL Default: None Warning This action is not idempotent by nature — running it again re-applies the scripts. mas_manage_custom_persistent_volumes ¤ Custom persistent volume definitions as a YAML list string (action: pvc ). Each entry requires pvcName , mountPath and size ; storageClassName defaults to the cluster RWX storage class. Required for the action (or provide mas_manage_custom_persistent_volumes_file ) Environment Variable: MAS_MANAGE_CUSTOM_PERSISTENT_VOLUMES Default: None The former discrete single-PVC variables ( MAS_APP_SETTINGS_CUSTOM_PVC_NAME , MAS_APP_SETTINGS_CUSTOM_MOUNT_PATH , etc.) are replaced by the list format — express the former SRE default as a list entry with pvcName: <instance>-<workspace>-cust-files-pvc and mountPath: /MeaGlobalDirs . Database Access ¤ db2_instance_name ¤ Db2 Warehouse instance name, used by the actions that execute SQL against the Manage database ( bim , logging with mas_manage_logging_is_prod ). Required for those actions Environment Variable: DB2_INSTANCE_NAME Default: None Not available when an external (JDBC) database is used; those actions fail with a clear message in that case. To find the instance name, go to the Db2 namespace and look for pods with label=engine . Describe the pod and find the app label value - that's your instance name. Example Playbooks ¤ Configure attachments and BIM together ¤ The following sample can be used to deploy Manage and configure attachment storage and BIM support as part of the same workflow: - hosts: localhost any_errors_fatal: true vars: mas_app_id: manage mas_app_channel: 8.4.x mas_instance_id: masinst1 mas_workspace_id: masdev db2_instance_name: db2w-manage mas_app_settings_persistent_volumes_flag: true mas_manage_attachments_provider: filestorage mas_app_settings_bim_mount_path: /bim roles: - ibm.mas_devops.db2 - ibm.mas_devops.suite_db2_setup_for_manage - ibm.mas_devops.suite_config - ibm.mas_devops.suite_app_install - ibm.mas_devops.suite_app_config - role: ibm.mas_devops.suite_app_config_manage vars: suite_app_config_manage_actions: - attachments - bim Import certificates from a file ¤ - hosts: localhost any_errors_fatal: true vars: mas_instance_id: masinst1 mas_workspace_id: masdev manage_certificates_file_path_local: /path/to/certs.yml roles: - role: ibm.mas_devops.suite_app_config_manage vars: suite_app_config_manage_actions: [import-certs] Add custom persistent volumes ¤ - hosts: localhost any_errors_fatal: true vars: mas_instance_id: masinst1 mas_workspace_id: masdev mas_manage_custom_persistent_volumes: | persistentVolumes: - mountPath: /MeaGlobalDirs pvcName: masinst1-masdev-cust-files-pvc size: 100Gi roles: - role: ibm.mas_devops.suite_app_config_manage vars: suite_app_config_manage_actions: [pvc] License ¤ EPL-2.0

docs.text: The actions to run, either as a list or as a comma-separated string — any combination of attachments , bim , birt , custfiles , eventstreams , imagestitching , import-certs , dbc-scripts , logging , and pvc . Required Environment Variable: SUITE_APP_CONFIG_MANAGE_ACTIONS Default: None Each action corresponds to one of the former suite_manage_*_config roles. Running multiple actions in one invocation is more efficient than invoking the role several times, for example attachments,bim configures both attachment storage and BIM support in a single run.
docs.title: suite_app_config_manage_actions

docs.text: MAS instance identifier — identifies which MAS instance contains the Manage application to configure. Required Environment Variable: MAS_INSTANCE_ID Default: None
docs.title: mas_instance_id

docs.text: MAS workspace identifier — identifies the workspace containing the Manage application to configure. Required Environment Variable: MAS_WORKSPACE_ID Default: None
docs.title: mas_workspace_id

docs.text: Application identifier — set to health when configuring a Health stand-alone application (supported by the attachments , bim and dbc-scripts actions). Optional Environment Variable: MAS_APP_ID Default: manage
docs.title: mas_app_id

docs.text: Attachment storage provider (action: attachments ) — filestorage , ibm , or aws . Optional Environment Variable: MAS_MANAGE_ATTACHMENTS_PROVIDER Default: filestorage Only the CR-based configuration is supported: the former db configuration mode (raw SQL against the Manage database) has been removed, and setting mas_manage_attachment_configuration_mode to db fails with a migration message. The variable is retained so that playbooks setting it to cr continue to work. When the provider is ibm , the bucket is created via the cos_bucket role with an object expiry rule enabled by default that deletes objects after 60 days — set COS_BUCKET_EXPIRE_RULE_ENABLE_FLAG=False to disable the rule, or adjust the retention period with COS_BUCKET_EXPIRE_RULE_DAYS .
docs.title: mas_manage_attachments_provider

docs.text: Customer files storage provider (action: custfiles ) — ibm or aws . Required for the action Environment Variable: MAS_MANAGE_CUSTFILES_PROVIDER (falls back to the legacy COS_TYPE ) Default: Value of the legacy COS_TYPE environment variable ( None if unset)
docs.title: mas_manage_custfiles_provider

docs.text: Manage log upload storage provider (action: logging ) — ibm or aws . Required for the action Environment Variable: MAS_MANAGE_LOGGING_PROVIDER (falls back to the legacy COS_TYPE ) Default: Value of the legacy COS_TYPE environment variable ( None if unset) Related settings: mas_manage_logging_is_prod ( false ; enables the Admin Center lockdown on production databases), mas_manage_logging_secret_name ( s3secretkey ), and mas_manage_logging_force ( false ; reconfigure logging even when a destination is already set).
docs.title: mas_manage_logging_provider

docs.text: Name used for the report server bundle when one is not already configured (action: birt ). Optional Environment Variable: MANAGE_REPORT_BUNDLE_SERVER_NAME Default: rpt
docs.title: mas_manage_birt_report_bundle_name

docs.text: The IBM Cloud Event Streams instance name (action: eventstreams ) — identifies the Event Streams service instance whose Kafka brokers Manage is configured to use. Required for the action Environment Variable: EVENTSTREAMS_NAME Default: None Related settings: mas_manage_eventstreams_location ( us-east ), ibmcloud_apikey , ibmcloud_resourcegroup ( Default ), db2wh_dbname ( BLUDB ), cpd_meta_namespace (the CP4D namespace hosting the Manage Db2 Warehouse), and mas_manage_eventstreams_manage_url_subdomain ( main ; the former role hardcoded this value, override when the Manage UI route uses a different workspace subdomain). Warning This action inserts a dummy Kafka password during configuration (not the actual one); the real password must be configured manually via the Manage administration dashboard afterwards.
docs.title: mas_manage_eventstreams_name

docs.text: Name of the PVC used for image stitching files (action: imagestitching ). Optional Environment Variable: IMAGESTITCHING_PVCNAME Default: manage-imagestitching Related settings: mas_manage_imagestitching_storage_class (defaults to the cluster RWX storage class), mas_manage_imagestitching_storage_size ( 20Gi ), mas_manage_imagestitching_storage_mode ( ReadWriteMany ), and mas_manage_imagestitching_mount_path ( imagestitching ).
docs.title: mas_manage_imagestitching_pvc_name

docs.text: List of PEM certificate strings to import into the Manage truststore (action: import-certs ). Requires manage_certificates_alias_prefix . Required for the action (or provide manage_certificates_file_path_local ) Environment Variable: None (passed as variable; manage_certificates_file_path_local uses MANAGE_CERTIFICATES_FILE_PATH_LOCAL ) Default: None When invoked from suite_app_config for the AI Service integration, these variables are set automatically.
docs.title: manage_certificates

docs.text: Local folder containing the .dbc scripts to load (action: dbc-scripts ). Required for the action Environment Variable: DBC_SCRIPT_PATH_LOCAL Default: None Warning This action is not idempotent by nature — running it again re-applies the scripts.
docs.title: mas_manage_dbc_script_path_local

docs.text: Custom persistent volume definitions as a YAML list string (action: pvc ). Each entry requires pvcName , mountPath and size ; storageClassName defaults to the cluster RWX storage class. Required for the action (or provide mas_manage_custom_persistent_volumes_file ) Environment Variable: MAS_MANAGE_CUSTOM_PERSISTENT_VOLUMES Default: None The former discrete single-PVC variables ( MAS_APP_SETTINGS_CUSTOM_PVC_NAME , MAS_APP_SETTINGS_CUSTOM_MOUNT_PATH , etc.) are replaced by the list format — express the former SRE default as a list entry with pvcName: <instance>-<workspace>-cust-files-pvc and mountPath: /MeaGlobalDirs .
docs.title: mas_manage_custom_persistent_volumes

docs.text: Db2 Warehouse instance name, used by the actions that execute SQL against the Manage database ( bim , logging with mas_manage_logging_is_prod ). Required for those actions Environment Variable: DB2_INSTANCE_NAME Default: None Not available when an external (JDBC) database is used; those actions fail with a clear message in that case. To find the instance name, go to the Db2 namespace and look for pods with label=engine . Describe the pod and find the app label value - that's your instance name.
docs.title: db2_instance_name

docs.text: The following sample can be used to deploy Manage and configure attachment storage and BIM support as part of the same workflow: - hosts: localhost any_errors_fatal: true vars: mas_app_id: manage mas_app_channel: 8.4.x mas_instance_id: masinst1 mas_workspace_id: masdev db2_instance_name: db2w-manage mas_app_settings_persistent_volumes_flag: true mas_manage_attachments_provider: filestorage mas_app_settings_bim_mount_path: /bim roles: - ibm.mas_devops.db2 - ibm.mas_devops.suite_db2_setup_for_manage - ibm.mas_devops.suite_config - ibm.mas_devops.suite_app_install - ibm.mas_devops.suite_app_config - role: ibm.mas_devops.suite_app_config_manage vars: suite_app_config_manage_actions: - attachments - bim
docs.title: Configure attachments and BIM together

docs.text: - hosts: localhost any_errors_fatal: true vars: mas_instance_id: masinst1 mas_workspace_id: masdev manage_certificates_file_path_local: /path/to/certs.yml roles: - role: ibm.mas_devops.suite_app_config_manage vars: suite_app_config_manage_actions: [import-certs]
docs.title: Import certificates from a file

docs.text: - hosts: localhost any_errors_fatal: true vars: mas_instance_id: masinst1 mas_workspace_id: masdev mas_manage_custom_persistent_volumes: | persistentVolumes: - mountPath: /MeaGlobalDirs pvcName: masinst1-masdev-cust-files-pvc size: 100Gi roles: - role: ibm.mas_devops.suite_app_config_manage vars: suite_app_config_manage_actions: [pvc]
docs.title: Add custom persistent volumes
